usedFor: Cal.com holds bookings and Google Docs holds the notes, so “Booking Created” can run “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Booking Created” in Cal.com, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new booking can add a line to a tab, so a running booking log stays current.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs can replace the tab's content, so choose add when logging bookings.
